lines.en: And while her outlooks may be twisted and remorse has no place in her personal dictionary, she’s still as fragile and full of blood as the rest of them.

lines.en: Perhaps she’s even more fragile.
lines.zh: 也许她更脆弱。

lines.en: Perhaps that’s why she’s focused so intensely on protecting herself from everyone and everything, even those who are on her side.
lines.zh: 也许正因如此，她才如此拼命地保护自己不去靠近所有人和所有事——哪怕是站在她这一边的人。

lines.en: It’s hard to say if I’m one of the people on her side or not.
lines.zh: 很难说我算不算站在她这一边的人之一。

lines.en: But I know that, even if it's not in the most ideal way, she's helped me more than anyone lately.
lines.zh: 但我知道，即便方式不怎么理想，最近她帮我的比任何人都多。

lines.en: I don’t particularly {i}want{/i} to talk to her about any of what I think I might be feeling, but...strangely enough, it seems like she might be the only person I {i}can{/i} talk to right now.
lines.zh: 我并不是特别{i}想{/i}跟她聊那些我觉得自己可能在感受的东西，但……奇怪的是，她似乎是我现在唯一{i}能{/i}说话的人。

lines.en: At least without feeling like I did something wrong.
lines.zh: 至少是唯一一个不会让我觉得自己做错了什么的人。

lines.en: Which I didn’t.
lines.zh: 而我没有做错。

lines.en: Nothing happened on Halloween.
lines.zh: 万圣节那天什么都没发生。

lines.en: And if it did...
lines.zh: 就算发生了……

lines.en: It wasn’t my fault.
lines.zh: 那也不是我的错。

lines.en: : I’ve decided to quit the soccer team.
lines.zh: : 我决定退出足球队了。

lines.en: scene kirinmassage27
: What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : Yeah.
: Once summer comes around, I’m just...done.
lines.zh: : 等到夏天，我就……结束了。

lines.en: : I can’t do it anymore.
lines.zh: : 我再也做不下去了。

lines.en: : It was nice getting to be around Miku and...I guess Karin, too. But seeing how much better everyone is than me is really fucking exhausting sometimes.
lines.zh: : 能和 Miku 待在一起挺好的……还有，我猜 Karin 也是。但看着每个人都比我强那么多，有时候真的他妈累死人。

lines.en: : I don’t really know much about soccer, but...I don’t think it’s supposed to matter how good you are as long as you’re having fun.
lines.zh: : 我不太懂足球，但……我觉得只要你玩得开心，水平高不高应该不重要吧。

lines.en: : Sure. But what if your brain directly links how fun something is to how good you are at it?
lines.zh: : 当然。但如果你的大脑直接把一件事有多好玩、和你有多擅长它绑在一起呢？

lines.en: : How am I supposed to enjoy myself when even being next to most of these girls makes me feel like a fucking useless amateur?
lines.zh: : 连待在这些女孩身边都让我觉得自己是个他妈没用的业余选手，我要怎么享受？

lines.en: scene kirinmassage28
: Wanna start a blowjob club instead? That sounds fun, doesn’t it?
lines.zh: : 那要不要干脆开个口交社？听起来挺好玩的，不是吗？

lines.en: : So fun that I can already feel myself getting fired.
lines.zh: : 好玩到我已经能感觉到自己要被开除了。

lines.en: : At this point, you could probably fuck someone in the middle of class and get away with it. Like {i}everyone{/i} knows that you’re into [teenage]girls and you’re still here somehow.
lines.zh: : 到这个地步，你大概能在教室正中间操一个人还全身而退。就像{i}所有人{/i}都知道你喜欢[teenage]女孩，而你不知怎么还在这儿。

lines.en: : Even so, I think the blowjob club might be a bit of a pipe dream right now.
lines.zh: : 即便如此，我觉得口交社现在大概还是个白日梦。

lines.en: scene kirinmassage29
: Maybe I’ll join some other club then.
lines.zh: : 那我也许去加入别的社团吧。

lines.en: : Our class has a lot of girls in the manga club, but...I don’t really think something like that would be a good fit for me.
lines.zh: : 我们班有很多女孩在漫画社，但……我觉得那种地方不太适合我。

lines.en: : Maybe a part time job?
lines.zh: : 也许找份兼职？

lines.en: : I don’t think work is a good fit for me either since the only place I’ve actually worked at fired me.
lines.zh: : 我觉得工作也不适合我，因为我唯一真正干过的地方把我炒了。

lines.en: : Oh, right. That was a thing.
lines.zh: : 哦，对。是有这么回事。

lines.en: : I don’t know. I guess I’ll just figure shit out when it happens.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。我想等事情发生了再他妈想办法吧。

lines.en: : All I know is that I can’t do {i}this{/i} anymore...and that I’m kiiiiiinda proud of myself for lasting as long as I have.
lines.zh: : 我只知道我再也{i}做不下去{/i}了……而且我还……有——点——为自己能撑这么久感到骄傲。

lines.en: : Can you be proud of me too, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 老师，你也能为我骄傲吗？

lines.en: : For managing to stay afloat in a sea full of people who keep using my head to hold themselves above water?
lines.zh: : 为了我在一片满是把我的头按住、好让自己浮在水面上的人海里，还能漂着不沉？

lines.en: : You’re really good at metaphors too, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 你还挺擅长比喻的，对吧？

lines.en: scene kirinmassage28
: Ooh! Metaphor club! We’d both be great at that!
lines.zh: : 哦哦！比喻社！我们俩都会很在行的！

lines.en: : Hey, it’s just an idea. You vetoed the blowjob club so I’m kinda just grasping at straws here.
lines.zh: : 嘿，只是个想法嘛。你否决了口交社，所以我在这儿有点抓瞎。

lines.en: : Just...
lines.zh: : 那就……

lines.en: : Keep an eye out for things you might be interested in, I guess...
lines.zh: : 多留意一下你可能感兴趣的东西吧，我觉得……

lines.en: scene black
Kirin stays attached to me for the rest of the gym period, but none of the others seem to mind.
lines.zh: Kirin 剩下的这堂体育课都黏在我身上，但其他人似乎都不介意。

lines.en: Apparently, she’s been doing this a lot lately- spending her time in the club helping others get over their stiffness instead of doing something to remedy hers.
lines.zh: 显然她最近经常这么做——把社团活动的时间花在帮别人缓解僵硬上，而不是去治好她自己的。

lines.en: And while I’d like to say that it’s nice she’s looking out for her teammates like that, I think there’s a high likelihood she’s only doing it to try and get into their pants.
lines.zh: 虽然我很想说她这么照顾队友挺好的，但我觉得她这么做很可能只是为了钻进她们的裤子里。

lines.en: I can relate.
lines.zh: 这点我倒是懂。

lines.en: It’s still weird thinking about how it will be here without her, though.
lines.zh: 但想到她不在这儿之后会是什么样子，还是挺奇怪的。

lines.en: Even if she doesn’t ever really {i}practice{/i}, I’ve grown familiar with her place atop the stage- basking in the sunlight pouring in through the oversized windows of the gymnasium.
lines.zh: 就算她从来不{i}真的训练{/i}，我也已经习惯了她在台子上的那个位置——沐浴在从体育馆超大窗户倾泻进来的阳光里。

lines.en: And I’m not all that interested in seeing how the stage looks without her there.
lines.zh: 而我对那个台子上没有她的样子，并没有多大兴趣。

lines.en: Sunlight on its own has never been worth admiring to me.
lines.zh: 阳光本身，对我来说从来不值得欣赏。
